caption:
It's 4am. Your neck won't turn left and the alarm is 90 minutes out.

Your shoulder's gone numb. The pillow's too high, then too low the second you flip it. Cold side buys about a minute. The angle never changes.

Eli & Elm's Side Sleeper Pillow is built for that angle problem: U-shaped cutout for your shoulder, latex-fiber fill you add or remove to set your own height. $114.99, queen.

Same mattress, same room. The cutout is designed so your neck doesn't have to twist just to keep your shoulder covered — the one variable a flat pillow can't fix.
